section_summary: This final section contains November 1946 telegrams about inspectors joining the Japanese Antarctic whaling expedition and the fleet’s passage through Lombok Strait. A despatch from Tokyo encloses reports on coastal catches, whale products, and preparations of the 1946–47 Antarctic whaling fleet for the week of October 13–19, 1946.

people.name: George Atcheson Jr.
people.role: United States political adviser in Tokyo

people.name: John K. Emmerson
people.role: Department of State drafting or routing official

keywords: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers

subfiles.title: Incoming telegram on boarding whaling inspectors
subfiles.about: Proposes arrangements for inspectors to board Japanese Antarctic whaling vessels near their refueling point.
subfiles.summary: Discusses inspector boarding arrangements and British wishes before the whaling fleet sails.

subfiles.title: Outgoing telegram on Australian whaling inspector Kenneth James Connan
subfiles.to: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, Tokyo; War Department Chief of Staff for Political Adviser
subfiles.about: Reports the Australian inspector’s departure from Sydney and expected arrival in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Kenneth James Connan was expected in Japan on November 10 to join the whaling expedition.

subfiles.title: Incoming telegram on Lombok Strait passage and inspector boarding
subfiles.about: Requests confirmation of passage through Lombok Strait and discusses an inspector boarding near Perth.
subfiles.summary: Netherlands East Indies permission remained pending; the fleet was expected near Lombok Strait around November 23.

subfiles.title: Despatch No. 690: Weekly Report on Japanese Whaling Activities
subfiles.about: Transmits three reports covering Japanese coastal and Antarctic whaling activities for October 13–19, 1946.
subfiles.summary: Encloses reports on coastal catches, whale products, and Antarctic fleet status.

subfiles.title: Weekly Report of Whaling Activities in Japanese Coastal Waters
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.about: Lists coastal stations, catchers, whale catches, idle vessels, and vessels under construction for October 13–19.
subfiles.summary: Records 34 whales caught and notes repairs to three catchers and construction progress on Kyokuyo vessels.

subfiles.title: Weekly Report on Whaling in the Adjacent Waters, No. 6
subfiles.about: Reports coastal catches and whale product output for October 13–19, 1946.
subfiles.summary: Lists 34 whales caught by three companies and tabulates oil, meat, blubber, bone meal, and other products.

subfiles.title: Whale Products Derived from Japanese Coastal Whaling Activities
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, using Japanese Bureau of Fisheries statistics
subfiles.about: Summarizes products from 34 whales caught during October 13–19, 1946.
subfiles.summary: Tabulates 407.56 metric tons of whale products across three companies.

subfiles.title: Weekly Status Report of the 1946–1947 Japanese Antarctic Whaling Fleet
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.about: Tracks conversion, repair, construction, and expected completion of Nippon Suisan and Taiyo Gyogyo fleet vessels.
subfiles.summary: Factory ships, carriers, and catchers were being converted or repaired at Japanese ports and shipyards for the Antarctic season.

subfiles.title: Weekly Status Report of the 1946–1947 Japanese Antarctic Whaling Fleet: company schedules
subfiles.about: Provides detailed company schedules for Nippon Suisan, Taiyo Gyogyo, and Kyokuyo vessels during October 13–19.
subfiles.summary: Lists vessel tonnage, locations, work progress, and completion dates. The Kyokuyo schedule includes three catchers and a whaling factory ship.
